description: This file contains abstract unit tests for subclasses of AbstractSubscriptions, focusing on subscription management, snapshot behavior, and member assertions within a pub-sub system implemented in Java, using JUnit and Akka actors.

classes.name: AbstractSubscriptionsTest
classes.description: An abstract test class for subclasses of AbstractSubscriptions, providing common test scenarios for subscription operations, snapshot consistency, and member verification.

methods.name: createEmptySubscriptions
methods.description: Tests that a new subscriptions object initializes with empty subscriber and topic maps.

methods.name: testVennDiagramMembership
methods.description: Verifies that subscriptions for various topics match expected actor subscribers, simulating a venn diagram of subscriptions.

methods.name: testVennDiagramWithFilter
methods.description: Tests subscription filtering logic applying custom topic filters for actors.

methods.name: testVennDiagramMembershipAfterRotation
methods.description: Checks subscription set membership after complex subscribe/unsubscribe operations simulating rotations.

methods.name: testVennDiagramMembershipAfterAnotherRotation
methods.description: Further verifies subscription memberships after multiple subscribe and unsubscribe actions that modify previous state.

methods.name: testSubscriberRemoval
methods.description: Ensures that removing a subscriber clears all their topic subscriptions.

methods.name: testSnapshot
methods.description: Validates that snapshots are immutable and reflect the state of subscriptions at the time of capture.

methods.name: changeDetectionIsAccurate
methods.description: Tests the return values for subscription and removal operations indicating whether the state changed.
